snippet.title: Nightmare Hunter Galaxy - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Hunt Nightmares, explore Vibrant Worlds, and save the Galaxy in this challenging and precise roguelike.  Explore randomly generated levels, collect 25+ powerful items, and test your skills in fast-paced combat.  

Wishlist & try demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2174800/Nightmare_Hunter_Galaxy/

Developer: Green Box Games
